research.facts:
FIA Targeting 2026 Regulation Tweaks — Energy Management
**Source:** ESPN, RaceFans — HIGH confidence
**Key facts (HIGH confidence):**
- FIA and F1 bosses discussing adjustments to 2026 technical regulations
- Problem 1: Excessive energy management in races — cars derating (cutting power) more than intended
- Problem 2: Large speed differentials between cars with full vs. depleted batteries on straights — safety concern
- 2026 power unit: 50/50 internal combustion / hybrid split; ~350kW ERS output; MGU-H eliminated
- "Overtake Mode" system (formerly "Manual Override Mode"): driver-triggered electrical boost of 350kW / 0.5MJ when within 1 second of car ahead; usable up to 337 km/h
- Overtake system working as designed but interacts with depletion problem
- 2026 car specs: wheelbase -200mm (3600mm→3400mm), width -100mm (2000mm→1900mm), weight -30kg (800kg→770kg), floor width -150mm, longer diffuser openings, no MGU-H
**Image search terms (imagn):** "Formula 1 car 2026" (generic F1 technical)
